mechanism: Brimonidine is an alpha-2 adrenergic agonist that may cause systemic absorption with potential additive vasodilatory effects when combined with tadalafil's phosphodiesterase-5 inhibition.
action: Monitor for symptoms of hypotension or syncope; brimonidine ophthalmic formulation has minimal systemic absorption making clinically significant interaction unlikely, but counsel patients on potential additive effects.
